visual.general_description: Fetal ultrasound screen capture with a small grayscale B-mode sector image and a pulsed-wave Doppler spectral trace.
visual.detailed_description: Black-background ultrasound screen capture. Top left shows on-screen scanner text including the words OB Fetal Heart, a probe or preset code, 2D and PW setting blocks, and the vendor name PHILIPS at the lower left edge. Top right shows TIB0.5 MI 0.3, a depth scale numbered from 0 to 10, a gray-scale bar and the printed label HR-PV 174 bpm. A small grayscale B-mode sector image of fetal anatomy sits in the upper centre with a small sample-volume marker. The lower part is a pulsed-wave Doppler spectral display with a velocity scale in cm/s labelled from 20 to -100 and a sweep-speed label of 66mm/s; it shows a series of repeating, similarly shaped triangular spectral envelopes pointing downward on the display, with two vertical white cursor lines crossing the strip. No calendar date, patient name or identifier is visible.

visual.general_description: Fetal speckle-tracking echocardiography screen with a four-chamber view, a strain-versus-time graph and a measurements panel.
visual.detailed_description: Black-background ultrasound analysis screen. Top left shows small coloured on-screen text (a view label, a clock time without a calendar date, a heart-rate value in bpm and an R-time label), too blurred to transcribe digit by digit. The upper centre is a grayscale four-chamber-style sector image with a colour-coded curved overlay along the ventricular wall and small coloured segment labels with numbers; a vertical colour scale at the right of the image runs from blue to red and a 5 mm scale label sits below. Lower left, red text reads Accept Pending followed by a peak longitudinal strain label with a percentage value that is too blurred to read reliably. Below the image is a strain graph titled Strain (%) with y-axis ticks -3, -9 and -15 and an x-axis labelled Time (sec) with ticks 0.23, 0.28, 0.33, 0.38, 0.43, 0.48 and 0.53. Several coloured curves and a white dotted curve share one trough-shaped cycle: each descends, reaches a lowest stretch and rises again, with the coloured curves spread apart from one another more over the lowest stretch than at the start and end; yellow dots mark single points on several curves. At the right a Measurements panel lists EDV 1.6 ml, ESV 1.2 ml and EF 28.2 %. The vendor name PHILIPS is at the lower left. No calendar date or name is visible.

visual.general_description: Composite of six printed electrocardiogram tracings labelled A to F.
visual.detailed_description: Composite image of six multi-lead electrocardiogram tracings on pink grid paper, labelled A to F. A and B form the top row, C and D the middle row and E and F the bottom row. Printed lead labels are visible at the left of panels A and C (aVR, aVL, aVF and other limb leads) and in panels B and D (V1 to V6). Small recording-settings text and a printed date and time stamp are visible along the lower edge of panels B and C. In A and B the complexes are tall, closely spaced and similar in shape, with a few complexes changed in shape; in B the V5 and V6 rows are flat lines. In C and D the complexes are narrower with intermittent differently shaped beats among the regular ones. E and F look like photographed printouts with tiny printed interval annotations along the top; E shows a rapid regular pattern across all rows, and F begins with a rapid regular pattern and then continues with fewer, more widely spaced complexes.
